how: The starter proposes the work and invites help, while later joining belongs to answering and building rather than the role itself.
Members are asked to complete the skin image and later to save the face under attack.
A member reports adding a blue pixel in a direct answer that asks for nothing back.
Members replace letters with a smaller face and revise template colors to resemble the skin.
Builders report continued letters, a first square and a contributed pixel.
Members ask for a link and supply coordinates or landmarks for the current and finished face.
Limited control of existing space is the stated reason to reject expansion.
Members rally to save the face and urge holding the remaining image.
Border and color revisions instantiate upkeep, while the added mechanism of keepers erasing agreed changes remains untestable from these exchanges.
The loss is attributed to the Netherlands by a participant without independently verifying which placers caused it.
Limiting a shift is explicitly justified as avoiding a fight with the neighbouring group.
Reports of neighbour expansion shape internal border deliberation and explicit acceptance of keeping black.
A mover says another place is necessary and reports having started a new face.
Another member selects a new spot after saying another move seems necessary.
An appeal asks the face's builders to help another work without establishing an answer or completed exchange.
Completion claims credit contributors and evaluate the surviving mark as a modest success.
A participant records a swastika appearing and quickly disappearing on a neighbouring face.
A participant mourns the face's attributed destruction during the event.
A fake episode fools readers and elicits checking, admission, joking, rating and an explicit April Fools defence.
A warning returns from unspecified Discord groups without establishing that this room moved its planning there or authorised a decision.
A member asks why the face is orange and proposes alternatives without an evidenced accepted explanation.
Members make jokes about the orange face as a tan and about making it all orange after the close.
Members propose backup locations while a face remains worth defending, without proving that either backup was built.
A participant reacts sarcastically to a swastika and welcomes its disappearance without establishing who removed it.
Requesting scripts does not establish that anyone deployed them.
Visible agreement and warnings from unseen chats cannot establish whether decided order existed across the whole effort.
Carrying an imported plan does not establish acting for this room toward another room.
Borrowing a plan and celebrating nearby works leave coalition membership unobserved.
A final location under FTL does not establish admission under a host's rules.
The fake-video explanation supplies no evidence of rules containing canvas discussion.
Closing congratulations do not show a decision to continue the canvas effort in another project.
Defensive recruitment and reports of somebody altering Doc leave an offensive call by this room unobserved.
Mourning attributed destruction does not establish an ongoing exchange of taunts with a rival.
Naming a destroyer does not establish a quarrel predating the canvas.
New jokes about the orange face do not establish inherited lore, ideology or faith in a color.
A loss attribution is not an attack call naming a rival through a prior tie.
Reported neighbour preferences establish no disclaimer, representation challenge or stated limit on committing this room.
The post-event orange joke establishes neither correction of an account nor a dispute over a preserved canvas version.
The appeal for another work does not say the mark brought its author into the subreddit.
A call to complete a creator's face does not document a new canvas room forming around the image.
Depicting the creator and congratulating contributors do not establish seeking or receiving the creator's notice.
Mourning a loss does not establish an argument about whether covering other works is fair.
A backup proposal and an answer urging staying do not document stress-driven withdrawal or repair of a personal quarrel.
Reporting complaints from Discord groups does not establish secrecy, spying or entry into a rival venue.
Calls to defend the face do not establish attacking it because of objections to canvas posts.
Reports of placing and doing one's part do not document fitting the effort around sleep, devices or competing duties.
A request for a link is not a report of site faults or fixes.
Importing a neighbouring plan does not establish divided membership or explicit pride in belonging to both rooms.
The opening request receives direct contribution reports of continued letters and a blue pixel.
The edited opening combines a call and revised design without preserving a separately timed start followed by recruitment.
Partial letters are already disappearing during construction, fitting upkeep of placed work before the whole face is finished.
Defensive reasoning about neighbour expansion does not establish subsequent direct talks with that neighbour.
Avoiding provocation is explicit but no prior settled agreement causing restraint is established.
Strain elicits a script request while the endpoint of actual machine placements remains unobserved.
A completion declaration marks something accomplished and contributors are congratulated.
Celebration precedes some fate reports but no passage makes it the cause of recording or preservation.
Loss reports and a closing evaluation do not show a transition into a continuing project.
Scarcity leads to moving only when relinquishing the threatened spot is chosen, since limited control can instead justify restricted defence.
An edited template and an accepted proposal do not preserve an order proving that posting the template settled the design.
A direct bare contribution report answers the opening call without demonstrating duties felt by all readers or responses through silent placement.
The help appeal and imported plan do not establish defensive shortage producing received help from another room.
A reported neighbour constraint does not establish border bargaining producing reciprocal help.
Recruitment to save the face does not establish its conversion into an offensive call.
The reasoned refusal answers a proposed expansion rather than an attack call.
Limiting a shift to avoid a fight does not establish an attack followed by negotiations.
Mourning attributed destruction does not establish this room attacking and subsequently pursuing a verbal contest.
Importing a plan while defence is needed does not establish a resulting coalition.
Repeated canvas calls do not establish a subsequent host restriction on canvas talk.
The reported neighbour preference establishes neither an agreement followed by refusal nor an at-agreement disclaimer.
Allow prospective backup siting after earlier losses, since members propose alternatives while a face still stands after relocation.
A relocation can include renewed building immediately because the mover reports starting a new face rather than merely selecting a place.
Include borrowing a plan from a neighbouring forum without inferring representative authority for its carrier.
Include internal accommodation of reported neighbour intentions before treating the resulting adjustment as a verified bilateral agreement.
Separate requesting scripts as a preparatory response from evidence that they actually supplied placements.
Include disputes over the prank's expiry when a later reader rejects its timing and the maker insists it remains a joke.
